implementation_cards.evidence: PR #403; snapshot backdrop and edge swipe
implementation_cards.acceptance: Verify 320/390/768/1440 widths, single dock, focus restoration, no map movement during Explore, 20 swipe trials each direction with no accidental navigation during vertical scroll; compare p95 frame time and cold entry against baseline; preserve 3–80% veil, floating rows and gold restraint.

implementation_cards.problem: Optional precision controller and quick zoom
implementation_cards.evidence: Library prototype static code: 112px/68px, 85ms lock, pointer capture; alternate pill buttons only faded, not disabled in visible source
implementation_cards.acceptance: Prototype behind opt-in; 10px dead zone, neutral hold no action, tap center recenter, lock until release/cancel, disable alternate controls, capped progressive pan/zoom outside bounds, spring return pill, +/- and keyboard alternatives, handedness; 20 trials per mode per hand on Android/iOS, zero stuck gestures, target >=95% intended mode, optional single haptic on lock; compare standard controls.
implementation_cards.dependencies: INNOV-01; physical devices; existing map gesture ownership

implementation_cards.evidence: Existing news/nearby #275 and feed #351; extend rather than duplicate
implementation_cards.acceptance: One card at a time, Explore max 2 per 10 min, map max 1 per 10 min, no cards during gestures/forms/modal or within 5s after; map card <=8% viewport and no control/pin overlap; dismiss/snooze, preferences, quiet hours, reduced motion, keyboard and polite announcements; measure interruptions per completed task and target no >5% task-time regression.
implementation_cards.dependencies: INNOV-01; existing feed and nearby ranking

implementation_cards.evidence: Proposal only; event dates #397 and location truth #393
implementation_cards.acceptance: Opt-in location or selected city; verified start time and venue, 5–30 min window only if plausible travel, expire at start or cancellation, no countdown pressure; no repeat after dismissal, no background location; synthetic timezone and stale-data tests; distinguish informational, devotional, discovery and time-sensitive cards.

implementation_cards.problem: Tenant style guide with live preview
implementation_cards.evidence: Composition plan #390 already covers fixed catalogue; extend its scope rather than create a parallel builder
implementation_cards.acceptance: Responsive preview 320/390/768/1440, scoped tokens for surfaces/type/spacing/accent, contrast validation, reset/undo, no cross-tenant changes, preserve navigation and accessible defaults; preview only until authorized save in isolated tenant.
implementation_cards.dependencies: #390 composition C4; tenant authorization and staging
